title: 第2534章 你这爷爷不是好人第2533章 小乞丐
content_zh:
陆宸把众人的反应看在眼里，他要的就是这种结果，让世人知道乱世也有对错。
在众人的注视下，陆宸挥了挥手：“好了，这里没你们的事，你们两个可以走了。”
“是！”两人心中大喜，连忙起身回了客栈。
之后，陆宸看向小乞丐，眼神温和的问道：“你叫小霖？”
“是的！”小乞丐微微点头。
陆宸道：“现在这个世道太乱，你可愿跟我走？”
“这……”
陆宸此话一出，周围看戏的人皆是一惊，很多武者更是朝小乞丐投去羡慕的目光。
如今世界大乱，民不聊生，别说弱者，就连一些过去执掌权柄的人都不知道什么时候死。
跟陆宸走，最次也能混个陆宸的小侍从。
有了陆宸这么一尊强大的武圣保护，这原本只能等死的小乞丐一下就有了活路。
而且，他可以跟着陆宸离开万象大陆，前往千叶大陆，还可能跟着陆宸修行。
在这之前，他们还对小乞丐冷笑嘲讽，现在却恨不得取代小乞丐，跟着陆宸。
小乞丐不知道众人想法，抬头问道：“恩公，跟你走是去哪？”
“我去哪，你就去哪。”陆宸回答。
小乞丐摇头拒绝：“谢谢恩公，但小霖不去。”
“为什么？”陆宸有些不解，不明白小乞丐为什么要放弃这千载难逢的改命机会。
小乞丐道：“爷爷身体不好，小霖要留下来照顾爷爷，爷爷离开了小霖会死的。”
陆宸心头一动，被小乞丐的孝心所感动。
在他看来，一个人的武道天赋是天定的，很重要，但作为一个武者，品行更重要。

这小乞丐虽然出身卑微，但孝道可嘉，武道天赋又极高，当真是一块瑰宝。
在陆宸心里，捡到小乞丐是他这次出来至今最大的收获，之前的收获和小乞丐相比不值一提。
过了半晌，陆宸道：“小霖，带我去见你爷爷，我们带着你爷爷一起离开这里。”
“恩公，真的吗？您真的愿意带着爷爷一起走？”
小乞丐有些难以置信，惊喜的确定。
“是的，我要带你们一起走。”陆宸笑着说。
“谢谢恩公！”小乞丐连忙跪下对着陆宸磕头。
“起来走吧！”陆宸扶起小小的小乞丐说。
“嗯！”
小乞丐开心的站了起来，在前面带路，心情格外的好，时不时的回头看陆宸。
这一刻，陆宸就是他的光，照亮了他原本晦暗的人生。
身后，不少人想要跟上去看，可一想到陆宸那恐怖的实力，众人又放弃了这个想法。
他们收回目光，感叹的同时继续做着各自的事，绝大部分人是想着快速离开此地。
陆宸魂力一直处于释放状态，不久后跟着小乞丐出了城，来到城外的一个山洞。
这个山洞不大，颇深，有个一百多米，洞口杂草丛生，一般不会有人注意到这里。
通过魂力，陆宸看到了小乞丐口中的爷爷，那是一个脸色苍白，有着三重武宗境修为的老者。
他受了很重的伤，经脉碎了很多，并且只有一只左手，右手有一半已经被砍了。
不过，真正让他变成这副模样的，最重要的还是他中了毒，而他解不了毒。
“看着”此人，陆宸眉头微皱。
content_en:
Lu Chen saw everyone's reaction in his eyes. This was the result he wanted, to let the world know that there is right and wrong in troubled times.
Under everyone's gaze, Lu Chen waved his hand: "Okay, you have nothing to do here, you two can leave."
"Yes!" The two of them were overjoyed and quickly got up and returned to the inn.
Afterwards, Lu Chen looked at the little beggar and asked with gentle eyes: "Your name is Xiaolin?"
"Yes!" The little beggar nodded slightly.
Lu Chen said: "The world is too chaotic now, are you willing to come with me?"
"This..."
As soon as Lu Chen said these words, everyone watching the show was shocked, and many warriors even cast envious glances at the little beggar.
Nowadays, the world is in chaos and people are in dire straits. Not to mention the weak, even some people who were in power in the past don’t know when they will die.
If you go with Lu Chen, you can finally become Lu Chen's little attendant.
With the protection of a powerful martial saint like Lu Chen, this little beggar who had been waiting for death suddenly had a way to survive.
Moreover, he could follow Lu Chen to leave Vientiane Continent and go to Qianba Continent, and he might also practice with Lu Chen.
Before, they had sneered and ridiculed the little beggar, but now they wanted to replace the little beggar and follow Lu Chen.
The little beggar didn't know what everyone was thinking, so he raised his head and asked, "My dear benefactor, where are we going with you?"
"Wherever I go, you go." Lu Chen replied.
The little beggar shook his head and refused: "Thank you, my benefactor, but Xiaolin won't go."
"Why?" Lu Chen was a little confused and didn't understand why the little beggar gave up this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to change his life.
The little beggar said: "Grandpa is not in good health. Xiao Lin has to stay and take care of grandpa. If grandpa leaves, Xiao Lin will die."
Lu Chen's heart moved, and he was moved by the little beggar's filial piety.
In his opinion, a person's martial arts talent is determined by fate and is very important, but as a warrior, his character is more important.
Although this little beggar comes from a humble background, he has commendable filial piety and extremely high talent in martial arts. He is really a treasure.
In Lu Chen's heart, picking up the little beggar was his biggest gain so far. The previous gains were nothing compared to the little beggar.
After a while, Lu Chen said: "Xiao Lin, take me to see your grandpa, and we will take your grandpa out of here together."
"My dear friend, is it true? Are you really willing to take grandpa with you?"
The little beggar was a little disbelieving and surprised.
"Yes, I want to take you with me." Lu Chen said with a smile.
"Thank you, benefactor!" The little beggar quickly knelt down and kowtowed to Lu Chen.
"Get up and walk!" Lu Chen said as he helped the little beggar up.
"Yeah!"
The little beggar stood up happily and led the way. He was in a particularly good mood and looked back at Lu Chen from time to time.
At this moment, Lu Chen was his light, illuminating his originally gloomy life.
Behind him, many people wanted to follow him and take a look, but when they thought of Lu Chen's terrifying strength, they gave up the idea.
They looked away and sighed while continuing to do their own things. Most of them wanted to leave this place quickly.
Lu Chen's soul power was always in a state of release. Soon he followed the little beggar out of the city and came to a cave outside the city.
This cave is not big, but rather deep, more than 100 meters long. The entrance is overgrown with weeds, and generally no one will notice it.
Through his soul power, Lu Chen saw the grandfather mentioned by the little beggar. He was a pale old man with a third-level Wuzong realm cultivation level.
He was seriously injured, his meridians were broken a lot, and he only had one left hand, and half of his right hand had been chopped off.
However, the most important thing that really made him look like this was that he was poisoned and he couldn't get rid of the poison.
"Looking" at this person, Lu Chen frowned slightly.
